# Northeast Community College

> > Northeast Community College is a Nebraska-based community college offering academic programs, workforce training, financial aid, and career pathways for students across STEM, agriculture, arts, and business fields.

Northeast Community College serves the Nebraska region with comprehensive degree programs, continuing education, and workforce development initiatives. The institution provides financial aid support, flexible payment options, and professional training through partnerships like the Law Enforcement Training Center.

- [Continuing Ed & Workforce Training](https://northeast.edu/continuing-ed-workforce/index.html): Continuing education, workforce training, GED, and professional development programs
